subject.title: refactor(sessions): route new session store bypasses through the accessor

question: Should this narrow accessor-bypass cleanup be rebased and landed independently, or folded into the active SQLite storage-flip lane at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96625?
rationale: The cleanup is aligned with the session-accessor boundary, but the branch is now dirty against current main and overlaps the protected session/transcript migration tracker, so a maintainer should choose the landing lane before repair work continues.

options.title: Rebase and land as a narrow cleanup
options.body: Resolve the current-main guard-ratchet conflict, update the debt baseline, add real behavior proof, and keep this PR scoped to the three accessor bypasses.

options.title: Fold into the storage flip
options.body: Move the useful cleanup into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96625 if maintainers want one coordinated session-storage landing lane.

options.title: Pause this branch
options.body: Leave this PR open but paused until the storage flip direction settles, avoiding churn on a conflicting branch.

recommendation.title: Rebase and land as a narrow cleanup
recommendation.body: Resolve the current-main guard-ratchet conflict, update the debt baseline, add real behavior proof, and keep this PR scoped to the three accessor bypasses.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored this cleanup and the current-main guard ratchet, and they are already carrying the session/accessor migration tracker context.
